reason: I've never heard of Claro, and the good price only comes if I sign up for another filter subscription, which is exactly the kind of thing I've been burned on. Paying $62.98 for the bottle alone, shipping included, for a brand I don't know is too much when I already carry a bottle.
objection: It's an unknown brand that might be a rebadged cheap bottle, and 'cancel any time' is what every hard-to-cancel subscription says.
would_change_my_mind: Independent lab test results for the filter plus free shipping on the bottle alone, with filters I can buy one-off with no subscription.
